sloka: मया विरहिता बाला रक्षसाम् भक्षणाय वै ।सार्थेन इव परित्यक्ता भक्षिता बहु बांधवा ॥३-६०-३४॥
transliteration: mayā virahitā bālā rakṣasām bhakṣaṇāya vai ।sārthena iva parityaktā bhakṣitā bahu bāṁdhavā ॥3-60-34॥

translations.english: The young lady having many relations, forsaken by me, has been (perhaps) picked up by a demon for food and later abandoned halfeaten.
